content.comment_body: Hello, could you share your AWS configuration? I'm trying to set up a project to run on my iPhone, but haven't found enough assistance to get it working. I followed the tutorial by [company_name], but the Elastic Beanstalk full access option shown in the tutorial isn't available for me. Which Beanstalk permission did you choose from the available options? Thanks in advance for your support. [user_name]

I selected "AdministratorAccess-AWSElasticBeanstalk" since it grants full administrative rights to create, modify, and delete Elastic Beanstalk applications and related resources. Note that previously supported managed policies like AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess and AWSElasticBeanstalkReadOnlyAccess are being phased out, though they may still appear in the IAM console. It's recommended to transition to the new managed policies and add custom policies as needed for any custom resources.

I used AWSIoTFullAccess. It appears that AWS has removed ElasticBeanstalkFullAccess, so I followed the instructions mentioned in the related forum topic ([product_name] / AWS missing permission), and it resolved the issue for me.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering challenges configuring AWS permissions for connecting [company_name] products to AWS, mainly due to outdated or inconsistent references in official tutorials and documentation. The removal or renaming of specific AWS policy options has led to confusion when following setup guides, which results in users facing difficulty completing their projects. Documentation and actual AWS options need better alignment given recent AWS policy updates.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, updated instructions from [company_name] that correspond with the current available AWS permissions, ensuring a seamless setup and successful operation of their projects on devices such as iPhones.
